rules.accepted_credit_types: Approved CNE related to the APRN role: providers approved by other state boards of nursing, national nursing credentialing associations or KSBN; CME only via an approved Individual Offering Approval (IOA); 1 contact hour = 50 minutes
rules.audit_note: If audited: certificates; for APRN hours, certificates and learning objectives when the certificate does not show approval for advanced practice nurses.
rules.notes: 30 contact hours of approved CNE related to the APRN role during the prior license period. APRNs with a Kansas RN license renew both licenses; the RN license has its own 30-hour requirement. No APRN pharmacology or opioid hours listed.
